note: Empty Page creates blank menu callbacks (dynamic routes rendering an empty page with an optional title) for block-built or blanked-out pages. Admin at /admin/structure/empty-page (route empty_page.administration, perm 'administer empty pages'). Each callback stored in config empty_page.settings as callback_<cid> = {cid, path, page_title, created, updated} plus a new_id counter; EmptyPages::routes (route_callbacks) registers a dynamic route empty_page.page_<cid> per callback, gated by 'view empty pages'. Saving a callback rebuilds the router. Medium/hard cases are grounded in empty_page.settings; reset/cleanup restore the shipped baseline (new_id:1, no callbacks).

evals.prompt: What is the Drupal empty_page module for, and where do you manage its callbacks (admin path / route)?
evals.expected_output: empty_page creates blank menu callbacks (routes that render an empty page with an optional title), useful for pages built entirely from blocks or to blank out a path. You manage callbacks at /admin/structure/empty-page (route empty_page.administration).

evals.prompt: In empty_page, where is each callback stored and what fields does a callback record hold? What dynamic route name is generated per callback?
evals.expected_output: Each callback is stored in the config object empty_page.settings as a callback_<cid> entry {cid, path, page_title, created, updated}, alongside a new_id counter. EmptyPages::routes registers a dynamic route empty_page.page_<cid> at the callback's path.

evals.prompt: Which permissions does empty_page define, and what does each gate?
evals.expected_output: 'administer empty pages' gates the admin screens (add/edit/delete callbacks); 'view empty pages' gates viewing the generated empty pages (each empty_page.page_<cid> route requires it).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site an Empty Page callback has been configured. Inspect the live empty_page configuration and state the internal path it serves.
evals.expected_output: The callback's internal path is 'ep-eval-path' (empty_page.settings callback_991 with path ep-eval-path, title 'EP Eval').

evals.prompt: This site has an Empty Page callback at internal path 'ep-title-path'. Inspect the live configuration and state its page title.
evals.expected_output: The page title for the callback at ep-title-path is 'EP Title Page' (in empty_page.settings).

evals.prompt: Using the empty_page module, create an Empty Page callback whose internal path is 'ep-hard'. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Add a callback_<id> entry to empty_page.settings with path 'ep-hard' (via /admin/structure/empty-page/add or config), then rebuild the router. A callback with path ep-hard now exists.

evals.prompt: Create an Empty Page callback with internal path 'ep-hard2' and page title 'Hard Two', and apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Add a callback to empty_page.settings with path 'ep-hard2' and page_title 'Hard Two' and rebuild the router.
